title: Validity of all clauses
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet, let $\mathrm{Ans}$ assign a Boolean value to each selector and pair of natural numbers, let $W\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ be a finite Boolean list, and let $xb:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. For every $t,a,j\in\mathbb{N}$ with $t<2^W$, $a<2^W$, and $j\le |x|+1$, and for every clause $\pi$, the clause evaluates to true under the good-clause evaluation using $\mathrm{Ans}$, the parameters $W,|x|,t,a,j$, and input bit $xb(j)$.
hypotheses_covered: answer function on selectors and pairs of natural numbers
